name: Ano Hi Ano Toki Ano Nuigurumi
original_name: あの日あの時あのぬいぐるみ
source:
A huge earthquake occurs in the middle of the night.
While her adults remain confused, the girl attempts to return to her home alone to return her best friend's stuffed animal.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ01165004.html]DLsite[/url]]
